# Desktop Web Applications

## Mission
Build robust SaaS dashboards, admin consoles, operational tools and data-heavy interfaces that remain usable on tablets and mobile.

## Workflow
1. Inspect routing, layout shell, component system, table/form patterns, permissions and API conventions.
2. Identify user roles, primary workflows, information hierarchy and high-frequency actions.
3. Establish reusable primitives for navigation, page headers, filters, tables, dialogs, forms, notifications and empty states.
4. Model screens as feature modules; keep shareable filters, pagination and selection in URL state when appropriate.
5. Design for realistic data volume with server pagination, sorting and filtering; virtualize only when justified.
6. Provide responsive fallback layouts rather than assuming a wide monitor.
7. Verify keyboard navigation, focus management, loading and failure behavior.

## Quality bar
- Prioritize task completion, scanability, consistency and predictable interactions.
- Confirm destructive actions and preserve user input after recoverable errors.
- Do not rely on color alone to convey status.
- Hiding a button is not authorization; enforce permissions on the backend.

## Deliverables
Describe workflows, reusable components, responsive behavior, accessibility and verification.
